rows.name: PMF.filter_apply
rows.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : PMF α} {s : Set α} (h : ∃ a ∈ s, a ∈ p.support) (a : α),
  (p.filter s h) a = s.indicator (⇑p) a * (∑' (a' : α), s.indicator (⇑p) a')⁻¹

rows.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.calibrated_reference_row
rows.type:
∀ {X Y A : Type u} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype A] [inst_2 : LinearOrder X] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Y]
  [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace Y] {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
  (P : X → A → PMF X) (q : X → Y) (fallback : X)
  (sample : UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.SampleTable X A N) (u : ℚ),
  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.CalibrationGood P hN sample ↑u →
    ∀ (x : X) (a : A),
      UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (PMF.map q (P x a)).toMeasure
          (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.referenceKernel hN q fallback
              sample (q x) a).toMeasure ≤
        min 1
          (↑u + ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.empiricalDefect q sample))

rows.name: UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.empiricalDefect_nonneg
UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.same_policy_projected_path_error
rows.type:
∀ {X Y A : Type u} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [inst : MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSingletonClass Y]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSingletonClass A] (p₀ : PMF X) (q : X → Y) (P : ℕ → X → A → PMF X)
  (Q : ℕ → Y → A → PMF Y) (π : (n : ℕ) → UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory Y (A × Y) n → PMF A) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ),
  (∀ n < T, 0 ≤ ε n) →
    (∀ n < T, ε n ≤ 1) →
      (∀ n < T,
          ∀ (x : X) (a : A),
            UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (PMF.map q (P n x a)).toMeasure (Q n (q x) a).toMeasure ≤ ε n) →
        UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
              (PMF.map
                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskHistoryMap q (fun ax => (ax.1, q ax.2)) T)
                  (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p₀
                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel q P π) T)).toMeasure
              (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw (PMF.map q p₀)
                  (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMacroControlKernel Q π) T).toMeasure ≤
            1 - ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T, (1 - ε i) ∧
          1 - ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T, (1 - ε i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range T, ε i

rows.name: UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw_tv_bound
rows.type:
∀ {H₀ Z : Type uHist} [Fintype H₀] [Fintype Z] [inst : MeasurableSpace H₀] [MeasurableSingletonClass H₀]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSingletonClass Z] (p₀ : PMF H₀)
  (K L : (n : ℕ) → UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory H₀ Z n → PMF Z) (ε : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ ε n) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), ε n ≤ 1) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory H₀ Z n),
          UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (K n h).toMeasure (L n h).toMeasure ≤ ε n) →
        ∀ (T : ℕ),
          UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p₀ K T).toMeasure
              (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p₀ L T).toMeasure ≤
            1 - ∏ i ∈ Finset.range T, (1 - ε i)

per_theorem_reviews.native_type:
∀ {X Y A : Type u} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : LinearOrder X]
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [inst_6 : MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableSpace Y] [inst_9 : MeasurableSingletonClass Y] [inst_10 : MeasurableSpace A]
  [inst_11 : MeasurableSingletonClass A] {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (p0 : PMF X) (q : X → Y) (P : X → A → PMF X)
  (fallback : X) (sample : UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.SampleTable X A N)
  (u : ℚ),
  0 ≤ u →
    UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.CalibrationGood P hN sample ↑u →
      ∀ (program : UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.ExecutableSupportSynthesis.Program X Y A) (T : ℕ)
        (S : Set (UEOT.V3.PathError.CausalHistory Y (A × Y) T)),
        1 -
              (1 -
                  min 1
                    (↑u +
                      ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.empiricalDefect q
                          sample))) ^
                T <
            (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw (PMF.map q p0)
                    (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMacroControlKernel
                      (fun x =>
                        UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.referenceKernel hN q
                          fallback sample)
                      program.toController.policy)
                    T).toMeasure.real
              S →
          have actual :=
            PMF.map (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskHistoryMap q (fun ax => (ax.1, q ax.2)) T)
              (UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw p0
                (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMicroControlKernel q (fun x => P)
                  program.toController.policy)
                T);
          have reference :=
            UEOT.V3.PathError.causalLaw (PMF.map q p0)
              (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.riskMacroControlKernel
                (fun x =>
                  UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.referenceKernel hN q
                    fallback sample)
                program.toController.policy)
              T;
          have pathError :=
            1 -
              (1 -
                  min 1
                    (↑u +
                      ↑(UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.NoisyFiniteRiskOracle.empiricalDefect q
                          sample))) ^
                T;
          ∃ (hp : 0 < actual.toMeasure.real S) (hq : 0 < reference.toMeasure.real S),
            UEOT.V3.TotalVariation.tvDist
                (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteConditionalStability.conditionedPMF actual S
                    hp).toMeasure
                (UEOT.V3.Compression.TheoryCompletion.UnifiedClosure.FiniteConditionalStability.conditionedPMF reference
                    S hq).toMeasure ≤
              min 1 (pathError / reference.toMeasure.real S)
